# Two Sum

## Solution

```python
class Solution:
    def twoSum(self, nums: List[int], target: int) -> List[int]:
        num_map = {}
        for i, num in enumerate(nums):
            if target - num in num_map: return [num_map[target - num], i]
            num_map[num] = i

```
